description: 眨眨眼，看看四周，安静地陪着你。
descriptionEn: Blink, look around, and keep you company.

description: 挥挥爪，眨眨眼，跟你打个招呼。
descriptionEn: Wave a paw and wink hello.

description: 迈着小步走一走，偶尔回头看看你。
descriptionEn: Take a little walk and glance back at you.

description: 蹲一下，翻个跟头，落地后开心地举起爪子。
descriptionEn: Crouch, turn a somersault, and raise the paws after landing.

description: 突然被拎起来，晃晃爪子，看看是谁在捣乱。
descriptionEn: Dangle the paws and look around to see who picked me up.

description: 气鼓鼓地晃两下，瞪你一眼，过一会儿就消气了。
descriptionEn: Give an indignant wiggle and a little glare, then calm down.

description: 歪着脑袋想一想，忽然有了主意。
descriptionEn: Tilt the head in thought, then perk up with an idea.

description: 两只爪子轮流敲键盘，写完了，抬头歇一会儿。
descriptionEn: Tap the keyboard with both paws, then look up for a break.

description: 一块一块叠起来，扶稳了，再满意地看看你。
descriptionEn: Stack the blocks, steady them, and give you a pleased look.

description: 戴上耳机，点点头，跟着音乐轻轻晃。
descriptionEn: Put on headphones and sway along to the music.

description: 三块积木轮流抛起来，眼睛紧紧盯着，可别掉了。
descriptionEn: Toss three blocks and watch closely so none of them fall.

description: 拿起小扫帚，把面前的灰尘扫干净。
descriptionEn: Pick up a little broom and sweep away the dust.

description: 抱紧大方块，小心挪过去，再稳稳放下。
descriptionEn: Hold the big block close, shuffle over, and set it down.

description: 拿着放大镜找一找，小虫子躲到哪里去了？
descriptionEn: Look through the magnifier. Where did that little bug go?

description: 挥一挥魔杖，变出几颗闪亮的星星。
descriptionEn: Wave a wand and conjure a few twinkling stars.

description: 闭上眼静一静，让脑袋里的想法慢慢理清。
descriptionEn: Close the eyes for a quiet moment and let the thoughts settle.

description: 戴上墨镜，敲敲键盘，今天也很有干劲。
descriptionEn: Put on sunglasses and get to work at the keyboard.

description: 高兴得跳起来，彩纸纷纷落下。
descriptionEn: Jump for joy as the confetti falls.

description: 吓了一跳，委屈一会儿，擦擦眼泪再试试。
descriptionEn: Get startled, have a little cry, then dry the tears and try again.

description: 铃铛响了，赶紧抬头看看。
descriptionEn: A bell rings. Look up and see what is new.

description: 低头看书，轻轻翻过一页，看到有趣的地方笑了起来。
descriptionEn: Read, turn a page, and smile at a good part.

description: 吹出几个泡泡，抬头看着它们飘远。
descriptionEn: Blow a few bubbles and watch them drift away.

description: 眼睛快睁不开了，打个大大的哈欠。
descriptionEn: Struggle to keep the eyes open, then let out a big yawn.

description: 脑袋一点一点，差点睡着，又赶紧坐好。
descriptionEn: Nod off for a moment, then catch yourself and sit up.

description: 收好爪子，安安稳稳地睡一觉。
descriptionEn: Tuck in the paws and settle into a peaceful sleep.

description: 睡眼惺忪地伸个懒腰，再眯一小会儿。
descriptionEn: Wake up with a sleepy stretch, then doze a little longer.

description: 转两下魔方，仔细看看颜色是怎么变的。
descriptionEn: Turn the cube a little and study how the colors move.

description: 认真拧几下，复原了，开心地举起爪子。
descriptionEn: Make a few careful turns and celebrate a solved cube.

description: 放好双爪，抬爪开始计时，拍下停表，再看看成绩。
descriptionEn: Paws down, lift to start, tap to stop, then check the time.

description: 拿到奖牌了，忍不住开心地跳一下。
descriptionEn: Get a medal and celebrate with a happy little hop.

description: 棱块飞出去了，赶紧扑过去接住。
descriptionEn: An edge piece pops out. Quick, catch it!

description: 拿起小教棒，指着魔方教你转一转。
descriptionEn: Use a little pointer to show you a cube move.

description: 泡泡越吹越大，突然破了，自己也吓了一跳。
descriptionEn: Blow a bigger and bigger bubble, then jump when it pops.

description: 耐心等了一会儿，提竿一看，怎么钓到一只小虫？
descriptionEn: Wait patiently and lift the rod. How did a bug get on the line?

description: 踩稳滑板，张开前爪，晃晃身子保持平衡。
descriptionEn: Stand on the skateboard and spread the front paws for balance.

description: 躲进纸箱，悄悄探出脑袋看看你。
descriptionEn: Hide in a box and peek out at you.

description: 喝一口汽水，突然打了个嗝，不好意思地笑了。
descriptionEn: Sip some soda, hiccup, and give an embarrassed smile.

description: 放飞纸飞机，转过身，看它飞到哪里去。
descriptionEn: Launch a paper plane and turn to watch where it goes.

description: 发现一颗落下的星星，伸爪接住，开心地抱好。
descriptionEn: Spot a falling star, catch it, and hold it close.

description: 撑好小伞，听着雨声，慢慢放松下来。
descriptionEn: Hold up an umbrella and relax to the sound of rain.

description: 往水坑里一跳，水花溅得到处都是。
descriptionEn: Jump into a puddle and send the water splashing.

description: 抓紧气球绳，飘起来了，低头看看地面。
descriptionEn: Hold the balloon string, float up, and look down at the ground.

description: 盯着爆米花，突然一声响，吓得抖了一下。
descriptionEn: Watch the popcorn and jump at the first loud pop.

description: 跟着蝴蝶转来转去，怎么又飞到那边去了？
descriptionEn: Follow a fluttering butterfly. Where is it going now?

description: 轻轻把纸船推下水，挥挥爪，看它慢慢漂远。
descriptionEn: Push a paper boat onto the water and wave as it drifts away.

description: 往前舒舒服服地伸一伸，再慢慢收好爪子。
descriptionEn: Lean forward for a good stretch, then settle back down.

description: 悄悄靠近小点心，发现你在看，又装作没事。
descriptionEn: Sneak toward a treat, notice you watching, and act innocent.

description: 左右晃晃，踩着拍子，开心地跳支舞。
descriptionEn: Sway from side to side and dance to the beat.

description: 从小门后探出头，好奇地看看，再走出来。
descriptionEn: Peek through a little doorway, look around, and step outside.

description: 抱好月亮，闭上眼睛，慢慢睡着了。
descriptionEn: Cuddle the moon, close the eyes, and drift off to sleep.

description: 刚拧两下，棱块就弹出来了，接回去后不好意思地看看你。
descriptionEn: An edge pops out after two turns. Catch it and give you a sheepish look.
